"I heard you crying last night." - I told her - "What did he tell you? Is everything going to be okay?"

A cold smile made its appearance in her face, she hugged me but I couldn't feel her love, she kissed me in my forehead but I only felt the wind coming through the half-opened window. "He's not here anymore honey, he's not coming back" - she told me.

It was midnight and I was still worried, I was on my bed looking at the ceiling, completely unable to fall asleep, the ceiling looked closer from this position as if it was going to fall down on me.

I heard his voice again but I couldn't understand what he was trying to say, what was happening to me? The ceiling was closer this time, I quickly got up and ran towards the door. The walls and ceiling were trying to crush me, the door was locked from the outside and I could hear the voice again, it sounded like static from a radio but his voice was there, as clear as water. I could finally understand that voice: Remember the key... It was inside one of my drawers, I desperately looked for it while the walls were still moving towards me, holes cracked open in them and blood started leaking from the holes.

I kept repeating myself it's a nightmare, it's a nightmare but I knew I was more awake than I have ever been before. I felt something cold inside one of my drawers, I took it, it was the key I was looking for. Desperately I tried to open the door, my bedroom was the size of a bathroom at this time and it was still getting smaller.

I finally opened the door, outside I could see a very narrow hallway, I ran through it as fast as I could touching the walls with my bare hands more than once, it was a horrible feeling, I could feel the humidity, the worn out paint and that red goo. The hallway was getting narrower with each step I took, I felt like somebody was following me so I decided to run faster. This house has never been so big before. I could hear the footsteps behind me, every time closer, I could feel his cold breathing in the back of my head. Everything's going to be okay, he kept telling to me.

"Lies" - I screamed as I reached the end of the hallway. As soon as I entered the living room everything was back to normal.

I looked through the window, there it was, my mother's tombstone, it has been there for years. Next to it there was another tombstone, it had my name written in it. I looked inside again, there he was, asleep in his sofa after spending another long night crying and drinking, he could never forgive himself for what he did.
